subject: tr-def
title: (R)TR.DEF.-----RE.ST.
description: Chart on book p. 520 (MP(II)-38). TR-DEF (trans-definition) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; RE-ST (restructuralism) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation) and C-CONT (composite continuance). From SOC-RT-INT: MT-INFO (multi-information) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From C-CONT: WO-EXT-PRI. From MT-INFO: POL-DYM (political dynamics). From T-C-IMP: POL-P (political policies). From WO-EXT-PRI: TRS (transition). From POL-P: INDIV-DY (individual dynamics).
